build_PreprocessEncodeModule: build a PreprocessEncodeModule instance with a PreprocessEncodeConfig to preprocess and encode language shards
run_PreprocessEncodeModule: run the PreprocessEncodeModule on a shard file to preprocess and encode text with an encoder
create_PreprocessEncodeConfig: create a PreprocessEncodeConfig dataclass with encode settings, encoder, language, and output directory
review_PreprocessEncodeModule_requiremen: review the PreprocessEncodeModule requirements method to return encoding resource requirements for submitit jobs
test_PreprocessEncodeModule_array: test the PreprocessEncodeModule array method to return the list of shard files for array job execution
